verdict.rationale: Proa documents Suspense boundaries that stream ready chunks out of order so slow data does not block the page. It also emits server-rendered HTML with only small per-island JS modules on a roughly 1.3 KB shared runtime, so content renders before or without heavy client code. Streaming rests on a single marketing-level mention. Missing for 10: in-depth streaming docs (fallbacks, flushing, error handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming behavior, and measured perceived-load gains.
